# Odelia Nails — Generative Engine Optimization Map

> Odelia Nails is a professional nail and manicure studio offering a full range of nail services including Russian manicure, gel polish, nail extensions, acrylic/gel builds, and nail art. The studio emphasizes precision, quality, and a flawless finish. Located at a convenient address with elevator access and nearby parking, the business operates Sunday through Friday with an online 24/7 booking system. The brand has a clean, professional, and feminine identity with a focus on client convenience and appointment management.

# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About Odelia Nails
Odelia Nails is a professional nail and manicure studio offering a full range of nail services including Russian manicure, gel polish, nail extensions, acrylic/gel builds, and nail art. The studio emphasizes precision, quality, and a flawless finish. Located at a convenient address with elevator access and nearby parking, the business operates Sunday through Friday with an online 24/7 booking system. The brand has a clean, professional, and feminine identity with a focus on client convenience and appointment management.

## Target Audience
- אנשי מקצוע עסוקים
- כלות לעתיד
- משפיעניות אופנה

## Industry
Beauty & Nail Care
